Author: AlexFlipnote
Name: The Holiest Fluffiness
Punchline: A tweak plugin born for the free company 'The Holiest Fluffiness', now open for all to enjoy.
Description: A tweak plugin born for the free company 'The Holiest Fluffiness', now open for all to enjoy.
Changelog: In the /hdebug Sources tab, every third-party repo now shows its number from Dalamud's custom repo list (for example "#3"), so it is easy to find in Dalamud's settings when you want to remove it. Sorting by repo also follows that order now, and the Unused third-party repos list is shown in settings order.
